text:
Maria G: Quick heads-up: reproducible failure in sample Android app on Android 12+ when corporate proxy is enabled. Using OkHttp 4.11, our Authenticator refresh path returns a new Request with Authorization header, but the retried request reaching the upstream shows no Authorization. Only happens behind proxy.

Jonathan K: Is the refresh done in an Authenticator or interceptor? Can you share minimal client setup?

Maria G: Using okhttp.Authenticator + an application interceptor that normally injects the header. Authenticator performs a synchronous Retrofit call: tokenService.refresh(...).execute() and then returns originalRequest.newBuilder().header("Authorization","Bearer "+token).build(); Logs show the Request object inside OkHttp has the header but network capture to upstream does not.

Alex P: If it disappears only with proxy, proxy auth (407) or hop-by-hop handling might be involved. Application interceptors run before proxy logic; network interceptors run after. Can you confirm behavior with a network interceptor?

Maria G: Swapped to a network interceptor to re-ensure Authorization right before the request goes on the wire and the issue stops reproducing. But we rely on app-interceptor for internal metrics, so changing breaks tests.

Jonathan K: For a pragmatic fix, keep the app interceptor for internal use but add a tiny network interceptor that checks for missing Authorization and fills it from the token store if absent. Eg: if (req.header("Authorization") == null) { req = req.newBuilder().header(...).build(); }

Alex P: Also check that you rebuild method/body correctly when returning a new request from Authenticator. Some proxies remove headers when request instances differ or body/method are omitted. Add debug logging of request.headers() both before and after proxy negotiation. If you can isolate to a small Java-only OkHttp repro (no Retrofit), file upstream.

Maria G: Confirmed disabling proxy eliminates the bug. Emulator + proxy environments are flaky; will try mitmproxy to make repro deterministic. I'll open a docs PR recommending network-level safeguard for token headers in proxied environments and call out synchronous refresh on same client can deadlock if not careful.

sdk-bot: [ci] devex/sample-app-smoke — FAILED — 1 flaky test detected :face_with_rolling_eyes:

Maria G: Thanks. I'll send PR and a small repro attempt for upstream. Ping me on review.
